newsitem.title: USA: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.
newsitem.headline: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.

text.p: USDA said the 33.588 million bushels wheat, 12.106 million bushels of corn and 1.419 million bushels of barley inspected in the week to Sept 5 included the following destinations (1,000 bu):

Gulf to Brazil 2,264; Chile 882; Colombia 791; Dominican Republic 121; Egypt 5,024; El Salvador 81; Guatemala 1,004; Israel 1,827; Jamaica 508; Mexico 529; Nigeria 882; Panama 411; Trinidad 341; Turkey 274; Venezuela 202.
Pacific to Taiwan 1,312; Egypt 3,840; Japan 1,514; South Korea 2,734; Pakistan 4,745; Sri Lanka 1,822.
CORN: Gulf to Colombia 519; Dominican Republic 1,203; El Salvador 181; Israel 298; Jamaica 648; Japan 5,443; Malta 394; Mexico 1,972; Panama 354; Spain 259; Trinidad 255; Venezuela 256.
